name: Miyabe Saya
source:
She is the childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c73278]Kouta[/url] and they've the same age.
She cames to his house since the death of the mother of Kouta for making the house chores that help him and his father [url=https://vndb.org/c72518]Nobutatsu[/url].

[spoiler]She has an affair with Kouta's father and when Kouta try to blackmail her that asking her for having sex together, she just said they aren't dating but -at first- absolutely don't physicaly resist.

In public, she calls Nobutatsu "Oji-san" but "in private" she calls him Nobutatsu-san. 
The reason she doesn't reveal her relationship with Nobutatsu to Kouta remains a mystery.[/spoiler]
